purpose: The agents themselves and what it takes to reach them: local companions, commercial providers, subscriptions and API access.
The only hub whose members are largely not repositories.

components.notes: Commercial agent providers reached through their own CLI or app, not through a repository of ours. Credentials are referenced by location only: the location is deployment-specific and is deliberately not carried in the manifest, and no credential value is ever written into one.

Subscriptions and quotas per provider. Worth declaring because an exhausted quota is indistinguishable from an incapable agent at the call site: on 2026-08-03 an agy run with an exhausted model quota returned exit 0 and did nothing, which was repeatedly misdiagnosed as a capability or permission fault.
Direct API access to provider models, as opposed to their CLI surface.

composition_notes.external_pattern: stack.v2.json in sovereign-private already carries external_components with kind and source for exactly this case. Here the proven component type access_surface is used instead, because it is the type the pinned resolver already accepts in a bundle manifest.
composition_notes.credentials_rule: Never a secret, only a location. Values stay in the credentials folder outside OneDrive and outside every repository.
composition_notes.skill_gap: TODO: no skill covers provider, subscription and quota inventory. Candidate name recorded in the proposal document: provider-subscription-inventory.
